scientific_scope: reused calibration screen; not fresh, not holdout, and not an unbiased generalization estimate

novelty_boundary.tested_hypothesis: OpenCV colored NLM can suppress chroma noise more strongly than luminance noise while preserving most luminance geometry
novelty_boundary.historical_audit: All located prior colored-NLM calls coupled hColor=h; no decoupled h/hColor sweep was found in this workspace or pazzle_will_be_killed

historical_exposure.interpretation: Predictions are committed before target decode in this experiment, but historical target exposure prevents a fresh-validation claim.

fixed_pipeline.layout: bilateral directional scores -> solve_buddies(max_edges=96), strict upright permutation of all 576 input tiles
fixed_pipeline.postassembly_order: RGB seam offsets -> bounded luminance gains -> exactly one full-canvas OpenCV colored NLM pass

target_access_order: verify input hashes and exact selected roster
solve and audit the shared strict layout
freeze the harmonized canvas and every arm prediction
write and read back a content-addressed prediction commitment
only then decode primary target PNGs once

target_free_safety_metrics.within_tile_luminance_gradient: mean absolute one-pixel Y differences excluding 20-pixel grid crossings
target_free_safety_metrics.within_tile_chroma_gradient: mean Euclidean one-pixel differences in OpenCV Lab a/b excluding 20-pixel grid crossings
target_free_safety_metrics.grid_ratio: mean absolute Y differences on grid boundaries divided by within-tile Y gradient

selection_rule: Among candidate arms passing every primary gate, choose maximum mean RGB SSIM; break exact ties by lower h, then lower hColor, then arm name. Do not access confirmation if no candidate passes.
confirmation_gate: The unchanged primary winner must pass the identical absolute SSIM, paired CI, win count, target-free safety and distinctness gates on records 504:540.
forbidden: new arm after primary target access
tile substitution, rotation, resampling, warp, or distortion
changes to the existing production ZIP
